title: MediaManifestHandoff
description: Output of the Media Agent tracking licensed visual assets retrieved for each scene.

scene_id.description: Scene identifier corresponding to script.json scene id

file.description: Relative path to the locally saved media file

origin_url.description: Source URL where the media was obtained

license.description: Verified license type (e.g., CC0, CC-BY-4.0, Pexels License, Pixabay License)

attribution.description: Mandatory creator/author credit and attribution string

duration_sec.description: Duration in seconds if video asset
